Vitality (HP): Displays the character’s vitality value. When HP reaches 0, the character will die.

Hit rate (TOHIT): Shows the accuracy of the attack, which belongs to agility (DEX) and skills as well as the total skill level.

Damage value (DAMAGE): Shows the degree of damage that can be inflicted on the opponent, and is subordinate to strength (STR) and skill level.

Avoidance rate (DEFENSE): Displays defense ability and belongs to agility (DEX).

Defense rate (PROTECTION): Shows the character's ability to withstand attacks and belongs to strength (STR).

Reputation (FAME): Rise as the number of monsters killed increases.

[b][生命值栏][/b]\n左侧显示生命值、灵力值以及当前经验值进度\n右侧为:
[b][Health column][/b]
The left side shows the health value, spiritual power value and current experience value progress.
The right side is the current level

[b][Mini map bar][/b]
The small map in the upper right corner can view the geographical information of your current area. Click to open the large map to see more detailed information, and you can automatically go to the target location by clicking on the map or the navigation on the right.
Tips: This interface can switch translucent display through system settings.

[b][current target][/b]
When you select any player or monster, the target's information will be displayed at the top of the interface, including the target's name, blood volume, class icon and gain information.

[b][Comprehensive information column][/b]
[Taskbar]
The taskbar displays your current task information in paging
Tips: If you are too far away from the mission location, you can click on the mission entry to quickly jump to the mission destination.

[Team Column]
The team column displays your current team member information in pages.
Tips: In this column you can quickly create a team or quickly apply for other teams.

[target column]
The target bar tab will display information about teammates and enemies around you.

[b][Quick tool bar][/b]
When you equip the armband (Ousters spirit), you will get a shortcut bar. You can click on the item you want to put in the backpack interface and choose to put it in the belt. Select the location in the shortcut bar and click to use it promptly and conveniently.

[b][Simple chat bar][/b]
displays real-time information in the chat channel you selected. Click the chat bar to expand the chat window.
Tips: This interface can switch translucent display through system settings.

[b][System menu bar][/b]
includes skill editing window, date, time and main function entrance.

[Skill Edit]
Click the "Skills" button to enter the skill editing interface, where you can preview all the skills you have learned and equip them in the skill wheel.

[Layout Edit]
There is a layout editing page in the skill editing interface. In this interface, you can add or delete skill buttons, and adjust the position and size of the buttons.

[time/date]
Displays the current game time (game time is not real time)

[Function menu]
There are four pages under the function menu, namely "Menu", "Experience Value", "Function" and "System"
There are main interface entrances under each page, such as backpack interface, equipment interface, team interface, guild interface, system settings interface, etc.
